03 / From the group chat to the ground

Three steps. Game on.

01 / CHOOSE

Pick your session.

Enter your name and mobile, then select a date and hourly slots. Your duration, total and advance are calculated for you.

02 / CONFIRM

Message the arena.

Tap Send on WhatsApp, then send the prepared message. Our team checks availability and shares payment details.

03 / PLAY

Bring your team.

Confirm with at least 50% advance, arrive for your slot, and settle the balance after your game.

Do you provide bats and balls?

Please bring your bats and tape balls. DCL provides the arena, wickets and lighting.

Is my slot booked when I select it here?

No. This is a booking request. Your slot is confirmed by the arena team on WhatsApp after availability and advance payment are checked.

Can I book a session that crosses midnight?

Yes. Choose consecutive hours, such as 11 PM to 1 AM. The booking date is the evening your session starts; 12 AM to 1 AM is the following calendar day.

How much advance do I need to pay?

A minimum 50% advance is required. The remaining balance is collected at the end of play on the session day.
